description: Create a comprehensive live deployment audit report documenting all frontend, backend, and edge worker functionality issues found in the codebase
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/LIVE_DEPLOYMENT_AUDIT.md with a structured audit report covering all categories of issues found during code review
Document each issue with: severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), file location, line numbers where applicable, description of the issue, and recommended fix

Organize issues by category: Backend API issues, Frontend issues, Edge Worker issues, Database issues, Authentication/Authorization, AI Integration, Payment Integration, Configuration/Environment, CORS/SSR/Routing, Rate Limiting/Security, Dead Code/Unreachable Paths, Error Handling
acceptance_criteria: LIVE_DEPLOYMENT_AUDIT.md exists at the project root with all issues documented
Each issue has severity, location, description, and recommended fix
Issues cover all 12 categories specified in the task requirements
